title: Machine learning-driven molecular engineering of nucleic acids
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,3810-3833
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01091H, Tutorial Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qien Shi, Hui Lv, Fei Wang, Chunhai Fan, Mingqiang Li
This tutorial review outlines machine learning-driven nucleic acid molecular engineering, from structure design and performance tuning to biomedical and information technology applications, guiding the shift from empirical to data-driven approaches.
